What does the Quran and the Prophet ﷺ say about zina? A full series starts here.

"And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way." (Qur'an 17:32)

"The one who commits an illegal sexual intercourse is not a believer at the time of committing illegal sexual intercourse..." (Sahih al-Bukhari 6810)

Over the next posts: every Quran passage (23) and the authentic hadith (29) on this subject, each in Arabic, English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish, with sources on the final slide.
